venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Baugh was the best player on the field. Faulkner would not let FAU play him one way. The short throw stayed open. Coleman intercepted one at Florida’s 5.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — cut draft. Fan rail stays empty until Charles approves.
headline: You cannot put a card on this offense. The short throw stayed free.

offense.body:
You cannot put a card on this offense. That is the point.

Faulkner does not install a system you can memorize. He asks a new question before you finish the last one. Same start. Different answer. Backside still live.

Creep up for Baugh and he throws the short one to Brown. First man misses. Brown scores from 49 yards. Long touchdown, short throw.

Follow the tackles who look like they are leading a run and the ball goes the other way. Brown. Three linemen already out in front. Later Clark. Same picture. On his touchdown those big people are already down the field.

Stay put and play Baugh and he runs it. Scores from 12 with those linemen actually leading him. Third quarter, everybody knows, and he still rips off 61 yards.

You never catch up to the last one. Baugh is already the next one.

Receivers out on the numbers. Brown and Wilson one behind the other. Extra men on Baugh and someone is alone with half the field.

More bodies on one side. A man in motion. FAU still counting when it snaps.

The fake run is both. Sometimes the tackles leave and the ball follows the three in the middle. Sometimes those tackles really are leading Baugh and he walks into it. When they need one yard, nobody leaves. Sneak. Philo from the 3.

They will pull a tackle on a pass too. The rusher has to choose. Chase Philo or honor the fake. Either way he is late. They showed it more than they cashed it.

Philo with Baugh behind him showed up once. A run. Then Wilson sitting in the grass for 19 yards. One look. Wilson moved the chains because he sits where you leave him.

Philo ran the offense. Eyes down when rushed. Step up, still find somebody. Stockton walked in from the 11 on a ball that was a little late. FAU crowded Baugh, the line looked like pass, Abrams over the top for 63 yards.

The pick is Mays. Ball off his hands. Sweeney sitting. When Philo holds it, the play dies.

Baugh is the night. Fourteen carries, 160 yards, three rushing scores. FAU filled every hole on some plays and he still ripped it. Faulkner’s job is to keep you from putting eleven on him. Clark is the change of pace. They will not run Baugh thirty times.

The line is clean. Almost no penalties. No late-shift disaster like last year. They are not getting out to the linebackers fast. The wide run is not ready. Faulkner still shows it so you have to honor the outside. He does not ask this line to block everybody. He leaves people unblocked on purpose.

The snaps over Philo’s head are Moore’s hands. Sumrall already said it. The one that lost twenty yards inside the five is the kind that loses real games. Philo ran it himself once. FAU’s end still there. Lost two yards. Idea fine. Play lost.

They block down the field like they mean it. Ten becomes thirty. Micah Jones blows up one man, then the next, and they throw him the last touchdown.

A coordinator who flexes to what you are weak at. A back you cannot tackle if they do not put extra men on him. A quarterback who ran the offense. Clean the snap, the play Philo ran and lost, and the ball off Mays. The rest is a headache.
bullets: Creep up for Baugh and Brown scores from 49.
Follow the fake and the ball goes the other way.
Stay put and Baugh rips off 61 when everybody knew.
Clean the snap, the play Philo ran and lost, and the ball off Mays.

defense.body:
FAU wants the short throw until you take it away. Florida never took it away.

Corners lined up yards off. Nobody standing where that ball lands. Henry and Valsin lived on the five-to-eight yard catch. Ninety plays. Ten of thirteen on third down. Sumrall said it. Third-and-1, you cannot have your corner nine yards off. That happened.

White will live with the short throw if they tackle. They did not. So FAU kept moving the chains.

White will not let a tackle get comfortable. Woods is how. One snap he is coming from the outside. The next he walks inside and someone else has that edge. Same down. Different rush.

When Veltkamp holds it, Coleman sells the middle. Veltkamp thinks the outside is one-on-one. It is not. Coleman shoots back outside, over the top of Valsin, and intercepts it at Florida’s 5.

He tips the next one. Johnson goes up and gets it. Bett beats the quarterback at the 1. Ball out. Johnson falls on it. McCloud wins fourth-and-2.

Safeties were clean. Coleman. Thornton. Clark played a real night in the slot and lost one ball to the corner of the end zone with no help. Valsin scored from 20. Same play Stockton ran the other way.

The pile at the 1. They had enough people. They lost the yard. The man on the outside left and Veltkamp walked in from 7. When Woods chases, FAU runs at him.

Later they sent four rushers and still played the corners off. That kills the deep ball. It leaves the short throw and the throw to the corner alive.

They were ready for how fast FAU plays. Veltkamp can throw it and run it. Sumrall called the defense atrocious at times because ninety plays is what you get when the short throw is free.
bullets: The short throw stayed open. Ninety plays.
White moves Woods so the tackle never settles.
Coleman sells the middle, then intercepts it at Florida’s 5.
The pile at the 1. The man on the outside. The throw to the corner.

specials.body: Durkin from 53. Clean. Florida never punts. FAU’s 18-yard punt starts Florida’s second score.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt starts Florida’s second score.

nextWeek.look: They will throw it short and the quarterback will run it. Sixkiller is their guy. Florida will still hand it to Baugh and keep asking a new question. White has to stand on that short throw and keep Woods on the outside when Sixkiller runs it himself.
